verify.note: Scripted-key recordings made with the pilot's 128K frame model (no human player). auto: per recording two replays - every hook call paired with the original from the same state (registers with R and PC, NextREGs 7 / 0x50 / 0x55 back, memory outside the sites, dead stack and copier attribute rows, the original's I/O; jumps into patched instructions; site bytes) and the pixel oracle (after each screen copy the sprite layer against the original plotters run on black / white buffers; wrong-x negative); boot tail with and without NEXLOAD; unit: every site at 4 incoming clocks, 64 IDs x mirror x phase + edges, 8 broken builds. JNext pace, AY order, native pictures, cheats and the real .NEXCLASH loader: pilot runs/beyond_the_ice_palace (games/beyond_the_ice_palace.md Results).

techniques.target: one plot call = one whole figure: 0xBEE6 (callers 0x7407, 0x7457, 0x7C9A), 0xBD9F (caller 0x8ECE)
ID in A (bit 7 mirror), world X in HL, Y in DE, camera 0x6DAE / 0x6DB0; 50 large and 14 small IDs
HLIB_SPEED_IN / OUT (V_SPEED latch) at every hook entry and exit; the copier's latch kept across its exit hook (V_CPSPEED)
hlib_r_set / HLIB_R_OUT at every exit and the boot tail: the particle and damage effects read R
copier window (open at the copy, wait at its exit hook, 5584 sixteenths); plot hooks pay into the debt; HLIB_PACE_V1
